faq.title: Ten questions that come up before a viewing
faq.lead: If yours is not here, call the building manager — it takes a minute.

items.q: What does the rent of 1 300 000 ₽ a month include?
items.a: Service charges and VAT are included in the rate. The furniture is included too and stays in the office. Utilities are the only separate line, billed by meter.
A two-month deposit of 2 600 000 ₽ and the first month of 1 300 000 ₽ — 3 900 000 ₽ in total.
Eleven months. A longer term is open to discussion.

items.q: How many people does the office seat?
items.a: Twenty-six workstations in five clusters of 4, 6, 6, 6 and 4, plus three private offices, a six-person meeting room and a kitchen-dining room with a table for ten.

items.q: Is any fit-out needed before moving in?
items.a: No. The fit-out was done by PRIDEX and the space is furnished. For comparison, fitting out a shell-and-core space takes three to six months.

items.q: Can partitions be moved or removed?
items.a: Yes, subject to the owner's approval. Bear in mind five round columns, three of which stand in the open-plan area.

items.q: How does the rate compare with the market?
items.a: Comparable fitted blocks of 150–350 m² at iCITY ask 80 000–100 000 ₽ per m² per year. This one works out at about 64 000 ₽ — 20 to 36 per cent below. Fit-out alone adds roughly 39 per cent to a rate.
A six-level car park with 950 spaces and entry straight from the Third Ring Road. EV charging and bicycle parking are available.

items.q: How do I get there by public transport?
items.a: Testovskaya (MCD) is a minute on foot, Shelepikha (metro and MCC) five minutes, Delovoy Tsentr and Mezhdunarodnaya ten minutes.

items.q: Who is the lease signed with?
items.a: Directly with the owner. A viewing can be arranged the same day. The lease itself is drawn up and signed in Russian.
